name: KYNESTRA Task Contract

lifecycle.queued: Accepted by Core and waiting to execute.
lifecycle.paused: Execution is intentionally suspended and may resume.
lifecycle.recoverable: Execution was interrupted and requires an explicit recovery or rerun path.

rules: Core is the source of truth for task persistence.
Modules must not write task rows directly.
Interrupted running tasks are promoted to recoverable during application startup.
Completion, failure and cancellation are terminal states.
Recoverable is not equivalent to failed.
Event handlers must tolerate duplicate delivery.
